issues.spec_citation: CQL Reference v1.5.3 Appendix B, HighBoundary/LowBoundary: omitted precision uses the default precision for Decimal inputs and returns the boundary at that precision.
issues.evidence: Focused pytest failed test_cql_log_requires_base_and_boundary_default_precision: translated HighBoundary(1.587) executed as TRY_CAST(HighBoundary(1.587) AS DOUBLE) and returned NULL in forced Python fallback; direct helper HighBoundary(1.587) returned 1.58799999.
issues.root_cause: The Python boundary macro returns DuckDB UNION(VARCHAR, DOUBLE). Direct TRY_CAST of that union to DOUBLE yields NULL; translated numeric boundary expressions need to normalize the helper output through VARCHAR before numeric casting.
issues.resolution: Translated numeric HighBoundary/LowBoundary now cast the public helper result through VARCHAR before the final DOUBLE TRY_CAST, preserving default-precision Decimal boundary output from DuckDB UNION(VARCHAR, DOUBLE) helper macros.
